ok in @3profile copy.html : hree things in index3.html are causing the issues: Your pins live inside a clipped box. #profile .mock-inner { overflow:hidden } and your .pin-grid is inside .mock-inner. So the leader lines (the ::after on .pin) can’t extend beyond the phone—they get clipped, which is why they appear inside the mock. The callout cards aren’t over the phone at all. .callouts is position:relative and laid out below the phone in the flow. You use negative offsets on the individual cards, but the container itself is still below the mock, so boxes look “under the phone”. Your JS computes dynamic line length/angle but CSS never uses them. The script writes --len and --angle on each .pin, yet the CSS uses fixed height and transform: rotate(...) values (142px, 130px, etc.). So the lines never point to the cards. Minimal fixes (drop-in) A) Let lines escape the phone (no clipping). Move the .pin-grid out of .mock-inner (keep it inside .profile-grid) or keep it where it is and switch the mock to overflow:visible (first option is cleaner).
.profile-grid { position: relative; } #profile .pin-grid{ position:absolute; top:50%; left:50%; width:300px; aspect-ratio:430/1000; /* same phone box */ transform:translate(-50%,-50%); pointer-events:none; }
